soundness_flags.label: honest_scope sanity reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted positive-follow-up reduction is outside P4: G_a(t|x)=(1-t)^2g_a(t,x) with bounded g_a forces G_a(1|x)=0, so the factor-preserving learner and its bounded clipping cannot reduce under a censoring floor.
